title: Fast Nearest Neighbor Search for $\ell_p$ Metrics
summary: The Nearest Neighbor Search (NNS) problem asks to design a data structure that preprocesses an $n$-point dataset $X$ lying in a metric space $\mathcal{M}$, so that given a query point $q \in \mathcal{M}$, one can quickly return a point of $X$ minimizing the distance to $q$. The efficiency of such a data structure is evaluated primarily by the amount of space it uses and the time required to answer a query.
